subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: What should be the canonical recovery and idempotency contract when compaction times out after a final reply may already have been delivered?
rationale: Source inspection shows real remaining gaps, but the durable fix changes session-state cleanup, outbound delivery idempotency, Telegram reconciliation, and operator recovery semantics across several active related trackers, so automation should not choose the policy boundary alone.

options.title: Choose a unified recovery contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical combined tracker while maintainers land or reject narrower compaction and delivery PRs, then require one end-to-end contract for terminal state, send idempotency, and in-product recovery.

options.title: Split after all parts have owners
options.body: Maintain separate canonical issues for compaction progress, lane starvation, duplicate delivery, and poisoned-session recovery, and close this only after each remaining behavior is explicitly linked and covered.

options.title: Limit core to current mitigations
options.body: Accept the current partial mitigations and treat broader duplicate-send/idempotency recovery as plugin or operator guidance, leaving some reported failure modes outside core guarantees.

recommendation.title: Choose a unified recovery contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical combined tracker while maintainers land or reject narrower compaction and delivery PRs, then require one end-to-end contract for terminal state, send idempotency, and in-product recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current live assignee and the strongest current-source routing owner across the compaction and delivery files touched by this decision.
